title: The State Of LLMs 2025: Progress, Problems, and Predictions
description: Comprehensive review of the LLM landscape as of January 21, 2025, covering DeepSeek R1, Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), inference-time scaling, benchmarks, and architectural developments. The review synthesizes key developments in the field and provides predictions for future directions.
author: Sebastian Raschka

title: A Survey of Test-Time Compute: From Intuitive Inference to Deliberate Reasoning
description: Comprehensive survey on test-time compute techniques covering the transition from intuitive inference to deliberate reasoning approaches in AI systems. The paper examines how models can allocate more computational resources during inference to improve reasoning quality, exploring techniques that allow LLMs to think longer about problems rather than relying solely on pre-trained capabilities.
author: Yixin Ji, Juntao Li, Yang Xiang, Hai Ye, Kaixin Wu, Kai Yao, Jia Xu, Linjian Mo, Min Zhang

title: DeepSeek-R1 and exploring DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B
description: Simon Willison explores DeepSeek-R1, a new reasoning model from Chinese AI lab DeepSeek, along with distilled versions based on Llama and Qwen. The model exposes its chain-of-thought reasoning in think tags; distilled models (8B, 14B, 32B, 70B) make the technology accessible; Simon successfully runs the 8B GGUF quantized version using Ollama; the reasoning process (20 paragraphs of thought for a simple joke) reveals more about the model's thinking than the output itself; models available under MIT license with some licensing compatibility questions for Llama-based distillations.
author: Simon Willison

title: Table as Thought: Exploring Structured Thoughts in LLM Reasoning
description: Research paper exploring the use of structured table-like representations for thoughts in LLM reasoning processes. The work investigates how organizing reasoning steps in tabular format might improve model performance on complex tasks requiring multi-step reasoning.
author: Zhenjie Sun, Naihao Deng, Haofei Yu, Jiaxuan You
